evals.prompt: Two agents need to use the same signed-in Chrome profile at once to inspect the calendar.
evals.expected_output: Independent connection names and task-owned tabs in the shared profile.
expectations: Runs the attachment launcher separately per task
Uses each printed session name on every command
Cleans up only the task?s own tabs and attachment

evals.prompt: Use Playwright in Edge Profile 2 to check a signed-in page. Chrome already has an extension token in the environment.
evals.expected_output: Attaches to Edge Profile 2 and uses interactive approval.
expectations: Uses interactive approval without forwarding Chrome?s token
Opens the task page in its own tab

evals.prompt: Use Playwright CLI to test the landing page in a fresh browser without using my signed-in profile.
evals.expected_output: A uniquely named fresh session is launched and closed.
expectations: Uses open with an explicit browser and unique session name
Keeps follow-up commands scoped to that session
